crossRefs.note: Let my meditation be sweet to him. I will rejoice in Yahweh.
I remember the days of old. I meditate on all your doings. I contemplate the work of your hands.
My tongue will also talk about your righteousness all day long, for they are disappointed, and they are confounded, who…
Sing to him, sing praises to him! Tell of all his marvelous works.
One generation will commend your works to another, and will declare your mighty acts.
They will speak of the glory of your kingdom, and talk about your power,
and you shall teach them diligently to your children, and shall talk of them when you sit in your house, and when you…
They talked with each other about all of these things which had happened.

translations.web: I will also meditate on all your work, and consider your doings.
translations.bsb: I will reflect on all You have done and ponder Your mighty deeds.
translations.kjv: I will meditate also of all thy work, and talk of thy doings.
translations.asv: I will meditate also upon all thy work, And muse on thy doings.
